correctness.rationale: Exact affine incidence and all triples are constructed and checked. The Gram identity yields the 21-by-21 Laplacian characteristic polynomial and 3^18 spanning trees; exact 3-adic Smith operations to precision 3^6 on six 20-by-20 reductions give valuations 0^12,1,2^4,3^3, with six exact Bareiss determinants confirming product and absence of other prime torsion. Genus 16 follows from 36-21+1; standard regular split thickness-one semistable component-group theorem supplies the conditional interpretation.

Their conclusions do not specify the 21-vertex Levi graph critical group; current exact-object and stronger-coverage comparisons found no statement of its full Smith decomposition. residual_risks: Unindexed design-theoretic tables or broadly stated lattice theorems could imply or explicitly give the same finite group.

value.rationale: The complete group is a natural invariant of the canonical nine-flex/twelve-collinearity-line configuration. Its pure 3-primary order, exponent 27 and eight nonunit invariant factors are not determined by point/line counts or the rational graph spectrum, and give a precise Néron component-group type on the associated genus-16 stable boundary. This narrow complete classification is useful for integral comparisons of classical incidence configurations; not presented as a general theorem.
